Commission approves the acquisition of a certain stake of Restaurant Brands Asia Limited (Target) by Lenexis Foodworks Private Limited (LFPL), Aayush Agrawal Trust (AAT), Inspira Foodworks Private Limited (IFPL), Aayush Madhusudan Agrawal (AMA), and Inspira Agro Trading LLC (IATL)
